# Gripello Docs

## Documentation Sets

- [Gripello Docs](https://docs.gripello.com/llms-full.txt)

## Docs

Every page below is available as raw markdown.

- [API](https://docs.gripello.com/raw/api.md): Every endpoint of the Gripello API, as served by gripello.app.
- [Guide](https://docs.gripello.com/raw/guide.md): How to do things in Gripello, step by step.
- [Account](https://docs.gripello.com/raw/guide/account.md): Sign up, sign in, password, two-factor, your data.
- [Gym admin](https://docs.gripello.com/raw/guide/admin.md): Staff, roles, map, settings, moderation.
- [Climbing](https://docs.gripello.com/raw/guide/climbing.md): Find routes, log ascents, follow friends.
- [Competitions](https://docs.gripello.com/raw/guide/competitions.md): Enter a competition or run one: categories, judging, live ranking.
- [Setting routes](https://docs.gripello.com/raw/guide/setting.md): For setters: routes, signs, walls, inventory, defects.
- [Setup](https://docs.gripello.com/raw/setup.md): Self-host Gripello with Docker Compose.
